question: Who launched Mission Mausam during the IMD’s 150th Foundation Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __Narendra Modi__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched **Mission Mausam** during the 150th Foundation Day celebration of the India Meteorological Department (IMD).
 
• The event was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Mission Mausam aims to make India **weather-ready** and **climate-smart** through advanced surveillance technologies.
 
• It will enhance forecast accuracy and provide critical air quality data to support sectors like agriculture and the blue economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The mission includes deploying **next-generation radars** and advanced surveillance technologies for better weather forecasting.
